name: hybrid-no-dense-with-readout
notes: Same as hybrid-no-dense (sparse + BM25 via RRF, no dense) but with LinearReranker.default() applied to the sparse VistaBackend query so the two-stage Wave->reranker readout influences the fused ranking. Tests whether the +345% Doozer / +20.9% synthetic regression lift transfers to LoCoMo Recall@K.
